This page only works when you open it from the QR code that Domora shows.

  1. Open Domora on your watch.
  2. Choose Connect. A QR code appears.
  3. Point your phone camera at it and tap the link.

The address you use away from home. It has to start with https.

Done. Look at your watch.

Domora picks up the connection within a few seconds. You can close this page.

To disconnect later: Home Assistant › your profile › Security › Long-lived access tokens › delete “Domora watch”.

That did not work

Your Home Assistant token is encrypted on this phone with a key that only exists in the QR code, so our server cannot read it, and it is kept there for at most 10 minutes until your watch collects it.
